reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank and syncAccount, shares Fintegra linking and downloading with existing providers, and extracts local unlinking for both consumers.

duplication.why: Removes most provider linking duplication, although GoCardless and linkSyncServerAccount retain parallel account creation and upgrade logic.

placement.why: Link orchestration, transaction downloading, endpoint configuration, and provider models remain in their established layers.

scope.why: The edits directly support the four requested changes and consolidate the affected provider flows.

maintainability.why: Shared validation and unlinking make future rule changes manageable, though the independently typed provider and account unions weaken the linking helper's interface.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing bank lookup and transaction import abstractions remain in use, and every linking handler uses the shared validation helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining GoCardless account persistence duplication is explicit rather than disguised through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere gains replaceExistingLink and a conditional exception to duplicate-link rejection; all linking paths continue through it.
